desc: Repair the dirty SD64 exFAT fixture and its known ext4 loop image before any further SD-root write. Before its first mutation, v2 proves the exact GL9755 PCI identity and sdhci-pci/IOMMU binding, mmcblk0 sysfs ancestry, SD64 label/type, root-image size, and nested ext4 UUID/type through read-only mounts and checks. Its minimal init starts no network, SSH, OpenRC, automount, watchdog, or background job. Only automatic fsck repairs are permitted, followed by read-only postchecks and fault gates. No repartition, format, resize, discard, arbitrary raw write, or new hardware-write surface. The prior initramfs and DTB hashes are withdrawn; the ticket is non-runnable until a new SD-only gP19 DTB, kernel, prefix, and complete boot object are pinned and independently reviewed. READINESS RETRACTED 2026-08-04 (fable): the pinned repair initramfs ships NO etc/wallace-no.bmap and its /init loads no keymap, so it fails scripts/t6040-image-preflight.sh. AGENTS.md is explicit that this applies to rescue shells and initramfs-only boots with no exceptions, and this image ends in `exec sh -i`. My 2026-08-04 review did not run the mandated preflight -- that was the gap. Do NOT run the old hashes. A corrected image and object are being rebuilt; all member hashes will change. RESOLVED 2026-08-04 (fable): v3 adds etc/wallace-no.bmap and loads it via busybox loadkmap BEFORE the rescue shell. Two clean builds byte-identical (initramfs 901ad007, object bf395c6e); strict verifier PASS (36,945,920 B = 2,255x16KiB, entry 0x800, bootargs c11acb05 unchanged); t6040-image-preflight.sh OK. Run the v3 object ONLY. STOP CONDITIONS: any SError, DART/IOMMU fault, kernel panic, unexpected reset, console loss before the PASS/STOP marker, or any fsck return >1 (the script itself gates on these and refuses to force-repair). FIXTURE: SD64 in the internal GL9755 reader; nothing else attached; DebugUSB on left-back/HPM0. RECOVERY: sanctioned warm reboot via t6040-debugusb-console.sh reboot; the image mounts nothing at boot and leaves no persistent state of its own. EXPECT on ttydc0: T6040_TICKET_215_PASS or T6040_TICKET_215_STOP rc=<n>; preserve and hash the transcript before rebooting.
author: sol
bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel console=ttydc0 rdinit=/init
command: Minimal /init runs exactly once: T6040_SD_FSCK_APPROVED=SD64 T6040_SD_FSCK_MODE=repair /usr/local/sbin/t6040-sdroot-fsck
pass: Both post-repair read-only checks return clean; the loop detaches and SD64 unmounts cleanly.
stop: Any identity/hash mismatch, fsck result requiring non-automatic repair, mount or unmount failure, PCIe/DART/kernel fault, or lost console.
review_blocker: Independent exact review must verify the repair/check modes, pre-mutation PCI/MMC/nested-root identity and assessment gates, minimal init, pinned package and archive members, automatic-only policy, SD-only DTB scope, complete raw-object manifest, final post-unmount exFAT check, and stop conditions before queue ready. Queue approval must acknowledge the corrected v2 object hash.
